newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up in speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up in speculative trade.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Thursday amid speculative trade and squaring of positions, dealers said.

"There was little genuine buying," dealer Ali Asghar of Fortune Securities said. Individuals took advantage of the speculative interest to square their positions ahead of the Friday-Saturday weekend, he added.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 3.21 points, or 0.23 percent, to close at 1,416.33. Losers led gainers 167 to 82. Hub Power Co rose 0.35 rupees to 33.50. ICI Pakistan fell 0.40 to 20.30. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
